verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a broad programmatic surface: an expressive GraphQL API for workflows and automation, SDKs, event subscriptions such as create_item and change_column_value, programmatic agent management, and a hosted MCP server. None of the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything the UI can do, so parity is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage reference, evidence that UI-only features (views, dashboards, admin settings) are reachable via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
